args.title: trellis-spa-special-indemnity-rider.docx
args.body:
TRELLIS BIOWORKS, INC. — PROJECT LATTICE
COUNTER-RIDER TO ARTICLE VIII (INDEMNIFICATION)
SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT — HALBERD HOLDINGS LP
Responsive to Wexler Bright LLP second-turn markup of 30 July 2026 (execution draft v4)

SECTION 8.2(d) — SPECIAL INDEMNITY FOR DISCLOSED PENDING MATTERS (COUNTER-RIDER)

(d) Special Indemnity. Solely with respect to the matters identified below, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Article VIII, the Sellers shall indemnify Buyer against Losses arising out of or relating to the following pending matters disclosed on Schedule 3.14, and no others:

(i) Schedule 3.14, Item 1 — Trademark Opposition (Lumenor Devices B.V. v. Trellis BioWorks, Inc., TTAB Opposition No. 91-284772, opposing registration of the TRELLIGEN mark, U.S. App. Serial No. 98/415,882); and

(ii) Schedule 3.14, Item 2 — Customer Dispute (demand of Bexley Clinical Partners LLC dated 3 April 2026 under the 2024 Supply Agreement).

Express Exclusion of Resolved Matters. For the avoidance of doubt, this Section 8.2(d) does not apply to, and the Sellers shall have no indemnity obligation under this Section 8.2(d) with respect to, any resolved, closed, or settled disclosed matter, including, without limitation, Schedule 3.14, Item 3 (OSHA Citation No. 1829445, Region IV, relating to the Company's Norcross facility, which was resolved by informal settlement with the penalty paid in full). The resolved matter disclosed as Schedule 3.14, Item 3 is expressly excluded from the scope of this special indemnity.

Aggregate Cap. The aggregate liability of the Sellers under this Section 8.2(d) shall not exceed Two Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($2,500,000). This special-indemnity cap is separate from, and in addition to, the general cap set forth in Section 8.3(b), and shall be the sole and exclusive limit of the Sellers' liability for Losses arising out of or relating to the matters described in clauses (i) and (ii) of this Section 8.2(d).

Survival. The indemnity obligations under this Section 8.2(d) shall survive the Closing for a period of twenty-four (24) months, and no claim may be asserted thereunder after such survival period has lapsed, except for claims for which a claim notice has been delivered in accordance with this Article VIII prior to the expiration of such period.

Interaction with Basket, Cap, and Escrow Provisions.

(1) Basket. The Deductible and related limitations described in Section 8.3(a) apply only to Losses arising under Section 8.2(a) (breach of representation or warranty) and do not apply to Losses arising under this Section 8.2(d). Accordingly, the special-indemnity obligations under this Section 8.2(d) are not subject to the Deductible; provided that nothing in this Section 8.2(d) expands the scope of the Deductible or otherwise alters the application of Section 8.3(a) to claims under Section 8.2(a).

(2) Cap. The aggregate cap of ten percent (10%) of the Purchase Price set forth in Section 8.3(b) governs the Sellers' aggregate liability under Section 8.2(a). The separate and additional aggregate cap of $2,500,000 set forth above in this Section 8.2(d) governs the Sellers' aggregate liability under this Section 8.2(d). The two caps are distinct and additive, and neither is diminished or increased by the other. Without duplication, in no event shall the Sellers' aggregate liability under this Article VIII (including under this Section 8.2(d)) be construed such that a Loss recoverable under this Section 8.2(d) is also recoverable under Section 8.2(a), it being agreed that Losses arising out of or relating to the matters described in clauses (i) and (ii) of this Section 8.2(d) are recoverable solely under this Section 8.2(d) and not under any other subsection of Section 8.2.

(3) Escrow. The order-of-recovery provision in Section 8.5 shall apply to claims under this Section 8.2(d) without modification: Buyer shall recover on any claim under this Section 8.2(d) first from the Escrow Amount, and thereafter severally from the Sellers in proportion to their Pro Rata Shares, in each case in accordance with Section 8.5. This Section 8.2(d) does not alter the priority of recovery set forth in Section 8.5, and the Sellers are not required to respond to a claim under this Section 8.2(d) directly or ahead of the Escrow Amount.

Conforming Consequence. Except as expressly set forth in this Section 8.2(d), this counter-rider does not amend, modify, or supersede any other provision of Article VIII of the Share Purchase Agreement. To the extent of any inconsistency between this Section 8.2(d) and the second-turn markup of Wexler Bright LLP dated 30 July 2026, this Section 8.2(d) controls with respect to the special indemnity for disclosed matters, and the Sellers do not accept, and this counter-rider does not incorporate, any other markup position (including the proposed thirty-six (36) month survival period in Section 8.1, the proposed tipping-basket revision to Section 8.3(a), or the proposed twenty-five percent (25%) cap revision to Section 8.3(b)).

— END OF COUNTER-RIDER —
